sahneler.metin: On a winter night, the North Sea broke through the Dutch dikes.
Water rushed into low-lying villages, and one thousand eight hundred thirty six people died.
A storm surge arrived on top of a spring tide.
It eroded them from the land side until they breached.
Many people were asleep when the water came.
Plans to raise the dikes already existed.
The Netherlands then built the Delta Works.

aciklama:
1953 North Sea flood broke through dikes and flooded the Netherlands. The cause: overtopping and breaching of weakened dikes by a storm surge.
